instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Energy services company providing energy efficiency audits, HVAC optimization, and building management system integration for commercial and industrial clients. Completed 200+ projects across hospitals, hotels, and manufacturing plants. Developing an IoT-based real-time energy monitoring platform. Multi-department organization with formalized budgets, quarterly business reviews, and a dedicated strategy function. We have invested in core systems (ERP, CRM, HRIS) but these are not always well-integrated. Innovation is a standing agenda item at board level with annual investment allocated, but execution velocity varies across business units.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.

fields.teamSize: The technology organization is structured into product-aligned squads with a central platform team of 5 engineers enabling shared infrastructure. Innovation is driven by a '20% time' policy where all engineers can dedicate one day per sprint to self-directed projects, plus a quarterly internal pitch competition where winning ideas receive seed funding and 3 months of dedicated squad allocation.

input.changes_since_last: Supply chain disruptions affected 8 product lines. Inventory digitalization project launched. Margins under pressure.

opportunities.title: Develop Customer-Facing Digital Self-Service Platform
opportunities.rationale: The sharp decline in customer retention (92% to 84%) and explicit feedback citing poor self-service tools represent a critical market defense threat. Modernizing the customer journey digitally is essential to stabilize revenue streams and proactively address churn before it impacts mid-tier clients.

first_actions: Map the top 5 most frequent customer service inquiries (e.g., usage reports, billing checks).
Develop minimum viable product (MVP) wireframes for key self-service modules.
Identify necessary API connections between CRM and core operational systems.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in self-service module adoption rate to >30% within 6 months.
milestones: Complete functional requirement gathering for MVP.
Launch pilot of core self-service functions to a beta group.
Achieve measurable deflection rate (reduction in inbound support calls) of 15%.

opportunities.title: Full Fleet IoT Integration and Data Layer Modernization
opportunities.rationale: The successful pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime, confirming the value of digitalization. The primary remaining barrier is complex integration between the new sensor data stream and legacy maintenance systems, which must be solved to scale effectively.

first_actions: Form cross-functional technical working group (OT/IT) to define data mapping standards.
Develop a centralized data lake or staging area for IoT sensor data aggregation.
Establish formalized change control procedures for integrating operational technology inputs.
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful, automated data flow from 100% of equipped assets into the enterprise maintenance system within Q3.
milestones: Pilot roll-out to a second, distinct asset group (e.g., HVAC units).
Reduction in mean time to repair (MTTR) achieved through predictive alerts.

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated Customer Experience (CX) task force, involving Sales, IT, and Product teams, with the explicit mandate to prioritize self-service tooling.
Conduct a formal systems gap analysis comparing required IoT data structure outputs against the input capabilities and APIs of all core legacy maintenance platforms.
Implement a structured 'Knowledge Transfer' program across business units to standardize innovation reporting and measure execution velocity against stated objectives.

key_weaknesses: Siloed Business Units: Execution velocity is highly variable, indicating a lack of standardized process ownership across departments.
Integration Debt: Core systems (ERP, CRM, etc.) are not well-integrated, creating significant data flow bottlenecks for advanced initiatives like full IoT rollout.
Reactive Customer Focus: The current effort appears focused on mitigating churn symptoms rather than proactively identifying adjacent services or market needs.

improvements: Digitalization Momentum: Successful pilot of IoT sensors validated the business case for predictive maintenance, moving the concept into actionable deployment.
Formal Budgeting: Innovation is maintained as a standing agenda item with allocated annual investment, providing necessary structure.
Risk Awareness: The severity and trend of customer retention decline are now clearly quantified and prioritized.
persistent_gaps: System Integration Complexity: Moving from pilot success to full enterprise rollout remains hampered by integrating modern data streams into aging, non-API-friendly legacy systems.
Cultural Alignment: The 'culture' barrier persists as a bottleneck for operationalizing digital capabilities across diverse business units.
achieved_milestones: IoT sensor pilot achieved 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines.
Formal approval secured for full fleet IoT rollout, validating the initial investment thesis.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant progress was made in the digital space (IoT pilot success), elevating technical capability and proving ROI. However, critical market issues (churn) emerged alongside persistent internal barriers (integration complexity, execution culture) which prevented a higher overall maturity score.
